note: Bavli: [Bava_Batra 133b:2](sefaria:Bava_Batra.133b.2) (9 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Ilish”. Amora of Rava's time; 'the sons of Rav Ilish'. Rare name; etymology unclear (uncertain).
Bavli: [Taanit 6a:6](sefaria:Taanit.6a.6) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Nehilai bar Idi”. Rare name, -ai ending. Etymology uncertain.

Bavli: [Avodah_Zarah 15a:6](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.15a.6) (60 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Sheisha, son of Rav Idi”. Common amora name. Same spelling as the biblical scribe שישא (1 Kgs 4:3), so may be Hebrew. Not in the paper.
Bavli: [Bava_Batra 59a:5](sefaria:Bava_Batra.59a.5) (5 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Bisa”. Father of R. Ḥama bar Bisa, grandfather of R. Oshaya. Etymology uncertain.
Bavli: [Bava_Metzia 66b:15](sefaria:Bava_Metzia.66b.15) (11 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav bar Shabba”. Also Rav Shabba, Rava bar Shabba. Probably 'born on Shabbat' (cf. שבתאי) - uncertain.
